thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Upgraded at New Street Research

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple (AAPL) Upgraded at New Street Research
text:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was upgraded by equities researchers at New Street Research from a “reduce” rating to a “neutral” rating in a note issued to investors on Thursday, The Fly reports.
Several other equities analysts also recently weighed in on AAPL. Maxim Group dropped their target price on Apple from $212.00 to $160.00 and set a “hold” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Royal Bank of Canada set a $185.00 target price on Apple and gave the company a “buy” report on Thursday. Wedbush reaffirmed an “outperform” rating and issued a $200.00 target price (down from $275.00) on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday. Piper Jaffray Companies dropped their target price on Apple from $222.00 to $187.00 and set an “overweight” rating for the company in a research report on Thursday. Finally, Jefferies Financial Group reiterated a “hold” rating and issued a $160.00 price objective (down previously from $225.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday. Two analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-seven have issued a hold rating and twenty-one have issued a buy rating to the company. The stock currently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $195.64.
